title: Transported global sections and constant quotient kernels
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$ be small sites and let $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,\mathrm{Set})\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E,\mathrm{Set})$ preserve finite limits. Let $F$ be the algebraic inverse-image datum of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. For a ring sheaf $R$ and global section $s$, define $\widetilde s$ by applying $L$ to the map $1\to R$ determined by $s$, precomposing with the unique map $1\to L(1)$ and composing with the underlying-ring comparison. For every test sheaf $T$, the image of its constant-valued map $s_T:T\to R$ equals the constant-valued map $\widetilde s_{L(T)}$. If a ring map $q:R\to S$ kills $s$, then $F(q)$ kills $\widetilde s$. In particular, for a commutative ring $A$, ideal $I$ and $a\in I$, let $\beta_a$ be the image of the transported sheafification section of $a$ under $\mathrm{constantMap}(F,A)$. Then $\beta_a$ belongs to the sectionwise kernel of $\underline A\to\underline{A/I}$ on every object of $\mathcal E$, with constants as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D7; sites.tex Tag 00YV; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 093M

proof.text: Factor a global section map through the terminal sheaf. Its inverse image is terminal because L preserves finite limits. Uniqueness of maps to L(1) proves the test-sheaf formula. For a ring map killing the section, ring_naturality and the ringZero graph identity prove that its transported section is killed as well.

The sheafification unit is natural for the quotient A to A/I, so a in I maps to zero on the source site. Apply the preceding vanishing result. Naturality of F.constants for that quotient identifies the result with vanishing of beta_a under the target quotient.

theorem transportedConstantSection_quotient
    {C E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory E]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology E}
    {L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)} [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (F : InverseImageData L) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I) (U : Eᵒᵖ) :
    (quotient JD A I 0).hom.app U ((transportedConstantSection F A a).val U) = 0
